note: Holt County publishes no public queryable zoning district layer. Its only GIS is the Assessor's web GIS, available by paid subscription ($30/month or $300/year per holtcounty.org/area-maps). The county zoning resolution is a PDF. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online found no Holt County or O'Neill zoning feature service, and the county planning administrator page links no GIS service. Only third-party parcel aggregators (Regrid, landrecords.us, Acres) carry zoning codes.
